sentences.text: Cancelling is refused with "Only placed orders can be cancelled" (HTTP 409) unless the status is `OrderStatus.PLACED`, so an order that has moved on stays as it is.
A cancel request for an order in any other state gets HTTP 409.
This Story changes OrderService.cancel, which OrderController.cancel calls for POST /orders/{id}/cancel; no test reaches it.
An order moves through PLACED, PAID, SHIPPED and CANCELLED.
The cancel endpoint is safe and well designed.
